title:
Campsie
Liverpool NSW - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Planned maintenance to upgrade the access network in Campsie and Liverpool (NSW) has now been completed. Work was carried out overnight as scheduled, and services should be fully restored from 1:54 PM AEST on 11 September 2026. If you experience any ongoing issues, please try restarting your equipment or contact support.

updates.content:
We are advising of planned upgrades to the access network in Campsie and Liverpool, NSW. The work is scheduled on 11 September from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST (NSW time). A single interruption of up to 60 minutes is expected between 1:00 AM and 2:00 AM.

During the window, some services may go offline. Order processing and diagnostics for affected services may be delayed during and shortly after the change. If needed, you can use mobile data to stay connected while your service is offline.

We will monitor the work and service performance throughout the window and will provide updates if anything changes. Thank you for your patience.

The planned network upgrades in Campsie and Liverpool (NSW) have now been completed. Service restoration was confirmed at 1:54 PM AEST on 11 September 2026. All affected services should now be operating normally.
